name: golden-slab-leak-caller-guess
redactedTranscript:
Agent: What are you seeing?
Caller: The floor in the hallway is warm and the water bill jumped. I think we have a slab leak.
Agent: Any visible water?
Caller: No puddle, just the warm spot.
Agent: Is the house on a slab?
Caller: Yes it is. We own it.
